rawIndexableTextContent: A local filesystem cloud backend for Ensembles. Overview EnsemblesLocalFile provides LocalCloudFileSystem, an implementation of the Ensembles CloudFileSystem protocol that stores sync data in a local directory. This is useful for testing, for syncing between apps on the same device, or for network-attached storage scenarios.
title: EnsemblesLocalFile
summary: A local filesystem cloud backend for Ensembles.

rawIndexableTextContent: The set of classes that may appear in a token returned by fetchUserIdentity(). The core uses this list when secure-decoding a persisted identity token.  Discussion Default: Foundation primitive classes (NSString, NSNumber, NSData, NSDate, NSUUID, NSURL, NSArray, NSDictionary, NSNull). Backends that return a non-Foundation token type from fetchUserIdentity() (e.g. CloudKit’s CKRecord.ID) must override this property to include their concrete token class.
title: cloudIdentityTokenClasses
summary: The set of classes that may appear in a token returned by fetchUserIdentity(). The core uses this list when secure-decoding a persisted identity token.
